title: Add a committed-DNA load-sweep regression under the stricter MiniJsonReader grammar
description:
## Summary
TSK-0136 (Done) hardened MiniJsonReader.cs to strict JSON (duplicate-key rejection, raw control-char rejection, strict number grammar). JsonDnaSerializer round-trip tests pass because canonical output is strict-grammar valid, but there is no regression that sweeps every committed DNA/creature fixture (e.g. Assets/Creatures/*.json and test fixtures) to prove none relied on the previously-loose grammar (leading zeros, leading '+', raw control chars, or duplicate keys). A single hand-authored file that violated the old grammar would now fail to load — a silent data-regression risk.

## Scope
- Add a focused EditMode/pure regression that deserializes every committed DNA/creature fixture through the reader and asserts success (or a documented allow-list for intentionally-invalid fixtures).
- If a committed fixture currently fails under the strict reader, report it (do not silently relax the reader); repair the fixture to valid JSON or surface it for a migration decision.

## Acceptance Criteria
- All committed DNA fixtures load under the strict grammar; the sweep is part of the test suite so future strictness/loosening cannot regress silently.

## Validation
Focused EditMode reader sweep; dotnet Tests build; git diff --check.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: Implementation and validation evidence (2026-09-07): Added Assets/Scripts/Tests/Editor/CommittedCreatureFixtureLoadTests.cs. The EditMode regression discovers all JSON TextAssets under Assets/Creatures through AssetDatabase, reports the discovered count, deserializes every current fixture through JsonDnaSerializer, and asserts the two historical schema-v1 fixtures (first_creature.json and first_creature_bak.json) remain explicitly rejected with the serializer's documented migration error. Focused Unity EditMode test passed 1/1 and reported exactly 17 fixtures: 15 schema-v2 fixtures loaded; 2 schema-v1 fixtures matched the explicit migration allow-list. `dotnet build ProceduralCreature.Tests.Editor.csproj --no-restore` passed with 0 warnings/errors. `git diff --check` passed. Unity console showed no errors or warnings. Residual risk: the two v1 files remain migration fixtures and are not loadable until an author-intent-preserving migration is defined.
